metadata.title: Returns & Refunds Policy
metadata.description: We refund products that arrive defective or damaged when you report the issue within 24 hours of opening.

accept.heading: When we accept returns
accept.body: We accept a return and refund only when the product arrives with a manufacturing defect, is damaged, or has a problem caused by us.
accept.report: Report the issue within 24 hours of opening the product.
accept.evidence: Send photos or videos showing the problem. We may ask for these to confirm it.
accept.inspect: Our team will inspect the product and verify the issue before we approve anything.

approved.heading: What happens once we approve
approved.collect: We'll arrange to collect the product from you.
approved.refund: Your refund will be processed within 7 days of approval.

declined.heading: When we can't accept a return
declined.intro: We can't accept a return or refund if:
declined.noDefect: The product was opened and our inspection finds no defect or issue.
declined.misuse: The problem was caused by misuse, mishandling, or accidental damage after delivery.
declined.late: You reported the issue after the 24-hour window.

note.heading: Good to know
note.body: We may decline any return that doesn't meet the conditions above. By placing an order, you agree to this policy.

report.heading: How to report an issue
report.body: Report it on WhatsApp at <number></number> within 24 hours of opening the product, with photos or videos showing the problem.
